params.body: Each project on the workbench at home gets a Remote Control server as a user service (`claude-rc@<folder>`, worktree mode, at most four sessions), so a new session can be started from the Claude app on the phone, each in its own worktree. The core instructions say how to add a project. Running now for `platform`. Proposed from the workbench at home.
params.title: Sessions from the phone: a Remote Control server per project
